# XrmGhost Documentation

> Local-first development for Microsoft Dataverse and Dynamics 365. XrmGhost runs your plugins and tests on your machine, so the deploy-test loop closes in seconds instead of minutes.

## Start here
- [Overview](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/overview/): what XrmGhost is, who it's for, and why teams adopt it.
- [How It Works](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/how-it-works/): the local-first execution model and the main moving parts.
- [Editions](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/editions/): the Standard and Pro editions and what each includes.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/getting-started/): install and run the CLI for the first time.

## Reference
- [CLI reference](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/cli/): command groups and the full CLI command reference.
- [Attributes reference](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/attributes/): declarative attributes for Dataverse plugin registration.
- [Architecture](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/architecture/): the documentation operating model and content source of truth.
- [Skills](https://docs.xrmghost.tech/skills/): agent skills for running and debugging plugins locally.

## Elsewhere
- [www.xrmghost.tech](https://www.xrmghost.tech): product overview, positioning, and editions.
- [github.com/xrmghost](https://github.com/xrmghost): organization profile and the full index of public repositories.
- [github.com/xrmghost/xrmghost](https://github.com/xrmghost/xrmghost): main repo — issues, feature requests, and release notes.
